findings: The decapentaplegic (dpp) gene product can be detected in the lumenal cavity between apposed peripodial and columnar cell layers of both wing and eye discs.
Specification of distinct cell fates in response to different concentrations of decapentaplegic (dpp) product may be achieved combinatorially by the saxophone (sax) and thickveins (tkv) receptors.
The decapentaplegic (dpp) gene product is widely diffusible in the presence of short gastrulation (sog) protein but tightly localised in its absence.
Ectopic expression of decapentaplegic (dpp) can rescue visceral mesoderm formation of heartless (htl) mutant embryos.
The decapentaplegic (dpp) product negatively regulates dachshund (dac) expression in the embryonic head.
Injection of protein synthesis inhibitors into early embryos induces expression of fushi tarazu (ftz) mRNA in virtually all regions of the embryo.

The mutant phenotype of flies that direct normal fushi tarazu(ftz) expression in blastoderm stripes but not in the developing CNS suggests that fushi tarazu (ftz) controls cell identity during neurogenesis.
The LRALL motif is needed for the strong segmentation function of fushi tarazu (ftz).
fushi tarazu (ftz) influences ftz transcription factor 1 (ftz-f1) activity by interacting with its AF-2 domain in a manner that mimics a nuclear receptor co-activator.
fushi tarazu (ftz) transcript localization in blastoderm embryos involves squid (sqd), which selectively binds to the fushi tarazu (ftz) 3' UTR.
tinman (tin) protein interacts directly with the groucho (gro) corepressor protein, for which the homeodomain is required.

Transcription complexes containing groucho (gro) may associate with the amino terminus of Histone H3 (His3) and these interactions may be propogated along the chromosomes due to the ability of groucho (gro) to participate in higher order structures.
groucho (gro) mediated repression requires Rpd3 function.

The bristle loss phenotype of Hairless (H) mutants can be suppressed by deleting components of the E(spl)-complex. The degree of suppression depends on both the number and identity of E(spl)-complex transcription units removed. E(spl) is Enchancer of split.
groucho (gro) and Hairless (H) both act to restrict neuronal cell fate in the retina.
Ectopic expression of hairy (h) prevents initiation of Sex lethal (Sxl) expression by interfering with X chromosome counting.
hairy (h) embryonic function is independent of the achaete-scute complex.
The hairy stripe7 (h7) enhancer mediates either Kr transcription factor dependant activation or repression in different regions of the blastoderm embryo.
Topoisomerase I-interacting protein (Topors) protein mediates hairy (h) protein polyubiquitination and can lead to hairy (h) protein degradation.
hairy (h) - Ecol\lacZ reporter gene constructs demonstrate that the separate cis-acting control units of the hairy (h) upstream region are sufficient to drive expression of individual stripes.
Northern analysis demonstrates that hb transcription factor encodes at least five overlapping transcripts divisible into two classes based on structure and time of expression.

Sequence alignments of orthologous fragments of hb transcription factor, Kr transcription factor and snail (sna) from a variety of arthropods and other phyla show that amino acid differences are not normally correlated with evolutionary distance between respective species. Amino acids directly involved in DNA binding are the most conserved, and binding specificity of a hb transcription factor finger from different species is not changed.
hb transcription factor controls thoracic and abdominal segmentation by acting as a classical gradient morphogen.

hb transcription factor behaves genetically as an antagonist of Polycomb (Pc), their mutant combinations lead to the ectopic expression of genes from the BXC and ANTC. Insufficiency of Polycomb (Pc) products can be corrected by insufficiency of hb transcription factor products or be exaggerated by the excess of the same products.

The on/off periodicity of the pair-rule gene even skipped (eve) involves the interaction of the hb transcription factor and Kr transcription factor proteins with defined even skipped (eve) promoter elements.

snail (sna) can mediate efficient repression when bound 50-100bp from upstream activator sites. Repression does not depend in proximity of snail(sna)-binding sites to the transcription initiation site.
The binding of snail (sna) protein to sites within single-minded (sim) regulatory sequences has been studied.
DNA-protein interactions: genome-wide binding profile assayed for snail (sna) protein in 2-3 hr embryos
C-terminal Binding Protein (CtBP) mediates transcriptional repression by the knirps (kni), Kr transcription factor and snail (sna) products in the Drosophila embryo.
Lack of Myocyte enhancer factor 2 (Mef2) gene expression in snail (sna) mutant embryos suggests that Mef2 lies downstream in the regulatory pathway.

Epidermal growth factor receptor (Egfr) identified as a candidate gene for hypoxia-specific selection (via an experimental evolution paradigm) that is also differentially expressed between control and hypoxia-adapted larvae.
Epidermal growth factor receptor (Egfr) signalling regulates ommatidial rotation and cell motility in the eye.
The jing and Epidermal growth factor receptor (Egfr) pathways are functionally related in the embryonic central nervous system midline and trachea.
Epidermal growth factor receptor (Egfr) signalling controls compartment size in embryos.
Epidermal growth factor receptor (Egfr) is required to negatively regulate epidermal expression of decapentaplegic (dpp) during dorsal closure.
white (w) function is required for the courtship disinhibition seen in wild-type males upon repeated exposure to ethanol.
The visual acuity of white (w) mutant males is impaired, but their abnormal courtship behaviour in daylight largely results from an overflow of light.

The absence, or insufficient levels, of extra-retinal white (w) protein increases the sexual arousal of males in general, of which the enhanced male-male courtship, observed in both chaining and single-courtship assays, may be an indirect effect.

The relative biological effectiveness of 252Cf neutrons has been determined for two different types of somatic mutations, the wing-spot test (using multiple wing hairs and flare) and reversion of eye-colour (using white).
Heterochromatic cluster containing Stellate repeats, cause PEV of a reporter mini-white (w) gene.
The hedgehog (hh) product stimulates maturation of ci into a labile transcriptional activator.
Cholesterol modification of hedgehog (hh) is necessary for hedgehog-dependent graded cell fate specification in the dorsal epidermis.
Ectopic hedgehog (hh) causes respecification of the wing anterior compartment. Reorganisation of the anterior wing is presaged by ectopic expression of decapentaplegic (dpp) and patched (ptc).
Misexpression of hedgehog (hh) in the soma induces germ cells to migrate to inappropriate locations in the developing embryo.
hedgehog (hh) is responsible for maintaining Connectin (Con) expression and its own expression in the embryonic trunk mesoderm during gut and tracheal development.
Overexpression of numb in Notch (N) mutants demonstrates a synergistic interaction suggesting that numb and Notch (N) function in the same genetic pathway.

Genetic analysis of Notch (N) mutants suggests that there are functionally different classes of Notch (N) alleles that affect different steps in the development of the peripheral nervous system. In particular one class affects a function of Notch (N) in the establishment of proneural clusters, while other classes interfere with the role of Notch (N) during lateral inhibition.
The intracellular portion has intrinsic activity and that the extracellular domain functions to regulate the activity.
The endogenous Notch (N) gene is rearranged in S2 cells.
A Serrate-Notch-canoe (Ser-N-cno) complex mediates essential interactions between glia and neuroepithelial cells in optic lobe development.
